arena_coding.description: Write `solve(coins, amount)` — return the fewest number of coins needed to make the amount, or -1 if impossible.

arena_coding.description: Write `solve(grid)` — grid is a 2D array of "1" (land) and "0" (water). Return the number of islands (groups of connected land cells, horizontally or vertically).

arena_coding.title: Longest Substring No Repeat
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s)` — return the length of the longest substring without any repeating characters.

arena_coding.title: Group Anagrams
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(strs)` — group anagrams together. Return an array of arrays where each inner array contains words that are anagrams of each other (each group sorted alphabetically).

arena_coding.title: Decode Ways
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s)` — a string of digits can be decoded using A=1, B=2, ..., Z=26. Return the number of distinct ways to decode the string.

arena_coding.title: Maximum Product Subarray
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — return the maximum product of a contiguous subarray.

arena_coding.title: Longest Palindromic Substring
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s)` — return the longest palindromic substring. If multiple with equal length, return the first occurring.

arena_coding.title: 0-1 Knapsack
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(weights, values, capacity)` — given items with weights and values arrays and a knapsack of given capacity, return the maximum total value (each item used at most once).

arena_coding.title: Word Break
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s, wordDict)` — return true if the string s can be segmented into a space-separated sequence of one or more dictionary words.

arena_coding.title: Minimum Path Sum
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(grid)` — given an m×n grid of non-negative integers, find a path from top-left to bottom-right that minimizes the sum. You can only move right or down.

arena_coding.title: Kth Largest Element
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums, k)` — return the kth largest element in the array (not the kth distinct element).

arena_coding.title: Rotate Image 90°
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(matrix)` — rotate an n×n 2D matrix 90 degrees clockwise in-place and return it.

arena_coding.title: Longest Common Subsequence
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s1, s2)` — return the length of the longest common subsequence of the two strings (characters need not be contiguous).

arena_coding.title: Trapping Rain Water
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(height)` — given an array of non-negative integers representing an elevation map where each bar has width 1, return how much water can be trapped.

arena_coding.title: Edit Distance
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(word1, word2)` — return the minimum number of operations (insert, delete, or replace a single character) required to convert word1 into word2.

arena_coding.title: Merge K Sorted Arrays
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(arrays)` — given an array of k sorted arrays, merge all of them into one sorted array.

arena_coding.title: Valid Sudoku
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(board)` — given a 9×9 2D array (with "." for empty), return true if the board is valid: each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain digits 1-9 with no repeats.

arena_coding.title: Jump Game
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — given an array of non-negative integers where each element represents the maximum jump length from that position, return true if you can reach the last index starting from index 0.

arena_coding.title: Unique Paths
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(m, n)` — a robot is on the top-left of an m×n grid. It can only move right or down. Return the number of distinct paths to reach the bottom-right corner.

arena_coding.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(prices)` — given an array where prices[i] is the price of a stock on day i, return the maximum profit you can achieve from one buy and one sell. If no profit is possible, return 0.

arena_coding.title: Letter Combinations of Phone Number
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(digits)` — given a string of digits 2-9, return all possible letter combinations using the telephone keypad (2=abc, 3=def, 4=ghi, 5=jkl, 6=mno, 7=pqrs, 8=tuv, 9=wxyz). Return sorted alphabetically.

arena_coding.title: Find Duplicate Number
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — given an array of n+1 integers where each integer is in the range [1, n] inclusive and exactly one number is duplicated, return that duplicate number without modifying the array.

arena_coding.title: Minimum Window Substring
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s, t)` — return the shortest substring of s that contains every character in t (including duplicates). If no such substring exists, return an empty string "".

arena_coding.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(heights)` — given an array of integers representing the height of bars in a histogram (each bar has width 1), return the area of the largest rectangle that can be formed.

arena_coding.title: Generate Parentheses
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(n)` — given n pairs of parentheses, generate all combinations of well-formed parentheses and return them in sorted order.

arena_coding.title: Course Schedule
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(numCourses, prerequisites)` — there are numCourses courses labeled 0 to numCourses-1. prerequisites[i] = [a, b] means course b must be taken before course a. Return true if it is possible to finish all courses (i.e., no circular dependency exists).

arena_coding.title: Balanced Binary Tree
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nodes)` — given a binary tree as a level-order array (use null for missing nodes), return true if the tree is height-balanced (the heights of left and right subtrees of every node differ by at most 1).

arena_coding.title: Find Peak Element
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — a peak element is strictly greater than its neighbors. Return any peak's index. (Assume nums[-1] = nums[n] = -Infinity)

arena_coding.title: Max Depth of Binary Tree
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nodes)` — given a binary tree as a level-order array (null for missing nodes), return its maximum depth (number of nodes along the longest root-to-leaf path).

arena_coding.title: House Robber
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — you are a robber who cannot rob two adjacent houses. Given an array of non-negative integers representing the money at each house, return the maximum amount you can rob tonight.

arena_coding.title: Subsets
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — given an array of distinct integers, return all possible subsets. Sort each subset, then sort all subsets lexicographically (empty set comes first).

arena_coding.title: Permutations
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — given an array of distinct integers, return all permutations sorted lexicographically.

arena_coding.title: Regular Expression Matching
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s, p)` — implement basic regex matching where "." matches any single character and "*" matches zero or more of the preceding element. Return true if the full string s matches pattern p.

arena_coding.title: Rotate Array
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums, k)` — rotate the array to the right by k steps (k may be larger than the array length). Return the resulting array.

arena_coding.title: Next Greater Element
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — for each element in the array, return the first element to its right that is strictly greater, or -1 if no such element exists.

arena_coding.title: Sliding Window Maximum
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums, k)` — given an integer array and a sliding window of size k, return an array of the maximum value in each window position.

arena_coding.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence (elements do not need to be contiguous).

arena_coding.title: Top K Frequent Elements
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums, k)` — return the k most frequent elements sorted in ascending order. Break frequency ties by choosing elements with smaller values.

arena_coding.title: Container With Most Water
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(height)` — given an array of non-negative integers where height[i] is the height of a vertical bar at index i, find two bars that form a container holding the most water. Return the maximum water volume (area = min height × distance between bars).

arena_coding.title: Search a 2D Matrix
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(matrix, target)` — search for a target in an m×n integer matrix where (1) each row is sorted left-to-right and (2) the first element of each row is strictly greater than the last element of the previous row. Return true if the target exists.

arena_coding.title: Rotten Oranges
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(grid)` — a 2D grid where 0=empty, 1=fresh orange, 2=rotten orange. Each minute rotten oranges spread to adjacent (4-directional) fresh ones. Return the minimum minutes until no fresh oranges remain, or -1 if impossible.

arena_coding.title: Task Scheduler
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(tasks, n)` — given a list of CPU task labels (A-Z) and a cooldown n (at least n intervals required between same-task executions), return the minimum total intervals to finish all tasks including idle time.

arena_coding.title: Sort Colors
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — given an array where 0=red, 1=white, 2=blue, sort it in-place so all 0s come first, then all 1s, then all 2s. Return the sorted array.

arena_coding.title: N-Queens Count
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(n)` — place n queens on an n×n chessboard so no two queens threaten each other (no two share a row, column, or diagonal). Return the total number of distinct valid arrangements.

arena_coding.title: Decode String
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s)` — decode an encoded string where `k[encoded_string]` means the encoded_string is repeated k times. Encodings can be nested.

arena_coding.title: Palindrome Minimum Cuts
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s)` — return the minimum number of cuts needed to partition string s so that every substring is a palindrome.

arena_coding.title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — return true if the array can be partitioned into two subsets with equal sum.

arena_coding.title: Implement LRU Cache
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(capacity, ops)` — implement an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache with given capacity. ops is an array of ["get", key] or ["put", key, value]. Return an array of results for "get" operations (-1 if key absent); "put" returns null.

arena_coding.title: Word Ladder Length
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(beginWord, endWord, wordList)` — return the length of the shortest transformation sequence from beginWord to endWord where each step changes exactly one letter and each intermediate word must exist in wordList. Return 0 if no path exists.

arena_coding.title: Graph Valid Tree
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(n, edges)` — given n nodes labeled 0 to n-1 and an array of undirected edges, return true if these edges form a valid tree (connected and contains no cycles).

arena_coding.title: Meeting Rooms II
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(intervals)` — given a list of meeting intervals [start, end], return the minimum number of meeting rooms required to schedule all meetings without overlap.

arena_coding.title: Minimum Arrows to Burst Balloons
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(points)` — each balloon is a horizontal segment [x_start, x_end]. An arrow shot at x value x_pos bursts all balloons where x_start <= x_pos <= x_end. Return the minimum number of arrows needed to burst all balloons.

arena_coding.title: Max Points on a Line
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(points)` — given an array of [x, y] coordinate pairs, return the maximum number of points that lie on the same straight line.

arena_coding.title: Validate IP Address
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(ip)` — return "IPv4" if the string is a valid IPv4 address (four dot-separated numbers each 0–255, no leading zeros), "IPv6" if it is a valid IPv6 address (eight colon-separated groups of 1–4 hex digits), or "Neither".

arena_coding.title: Critical Connections in a Network
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(n, connections)` — given n servers (0-indexed) and a list of undirected connections, return all critical connections (bridges) whose removal disconnects the network. Return each bridge with the smaller node index first, and sort the result.

arena_coding.title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nodes)` — `nodes` is a level-order array representation of a binary tree (null for missing nodes). Serialize the tree to a string, then deserialize it back, and return the level-order array. Trailing nulls may be omitted.

arena_coding.title: Alien Dictionary
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(words)` — given a list of words in lexicographic order according to an alien language, return the sorted order of the unique characters in that language as a string. If the order is invalid (cyclic dependency), return "".

arena_coding.title: Minimum Cost to Connect Sticks
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(sticks)` — you have an array of stick lengths. Each step you pick the two shortest sticks, join them (cost = their sum), and put the new stick back. Return the minimum total cost to connect all sticks into one.

arena_coding.title: Find All Anagrams in String
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s, p)` — return all start indices of anagram substrings of p found in s. Return them sorted in ascending order.

arena_coding.title: Min Stack
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(ops)` — implement a stack supporting push, pop, and getMin in O(1). ops is an array of ["push",val], ["pop"], or ["getMin"]. push/pop return null; getMin returns the current minimum. Assume getMin and pop are never called on an empty stack.

arena_coding.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(n, flights, src, dst, k)` — n cities labeled 0 to n-1, flights[i] = [from, to, price]. Find the cheapest price from src to dst with at most k stops. Return -1 if no valid route exists.

arena_coding.title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums1, nums2)` — return the median of the two sorted arrays merged. If the combined length is even, return the average of the two middle values as a float with one decimal place.

arena_coding.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — given an unsorted array of integers, return the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence. Your algorithm must run in O(n) time using a hash set.

arena_coding.title: Product of Array Except Self
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — return an array where output[i] equals the product of all elements in nums except nums[i]. Do not use division.

arena_coding.title: Burst Balloons
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — you have n balloons, each labeled with a number. Bursting balloon i earns nums[i-1] * nums[i] * nums[i+1] coins (treat out-of-bounds indices as 1). Return the maximum total coins you can collect by bursting all balloons optimally.

arena_coding.title: 3Sum
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — find all unique triplets [a, b, c] such that a + b + c = 0. Sort each triplet in ascending order, then sort all triplets lexicographically.

arena_coding.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums, target)` — given an integer array sorted ascending then rotated at some pivot (no duplicates), return the index of the target or -1 if not found.

arena_coding.title: Majority Element
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — return the element that appears more than ⌊n/2⌋ times. The majority element is guaranteed to exist.

arena_coding.title: Daily Temperatures
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(temperatures)` — return an array where answer[i] is the number of days you must wait after day i for a warmer temperature. If no future day is warmer, answer[i] = 0.

arena_coding.title: Longest Mountain in Array
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — a mountain subarray is a contiguous subarray where elements strictly increase to a peak then strictly decrease (minimum length 3). Return the length of the longest mountain, or 0 if none exists.

arena_coding.title: Zigzag Level Order
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nodes)` — given a binary tree as a level-order array (null for missing nodes), return the zigzag level-order traversal: left→right for the first level, right→left for the second, and so on alternating.

arena_coding.title: Combination Sum
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(candidates, target)` — find all unique combinations where the chosen numbers sum to target. Numbers may be reused. Return results sorted lexicographically.

arena_coding.title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(s, k)` — you can replace at most k characters in the string with any letter. Return the length of the longest substring containing only one distinct character after the replacements.

arena_coding.title: Count of Smaller Numbers After Self
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — return an array where answer[i] is the count of elements strictly smaller than nums[i] that appear to its right.

arena_coding.title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(heights)` — given an m×n integer matrix of heights, return all positions [r,c] where rain water can flow to both the Pacific Ocean (top/left border) and the Atlantic Ocean (bottom/right border). Water flows to adjacent cells with equal or lower height. Return positions sorted by row then column.

arena_coding.title: Reconstruct Itinerary
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(tickets)` — given a list of airline tickets [from, to], reconstruct the itinerary starting from "JFK". Use all tickets exactly once. If multiple valid itineraries exist, return the one with the smallest lexical order.

arena_coding.title: Range Sum Query
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums, queries)` — given an integer array, answer multiple range sum queries. queries is an array of [left, right] (0-indexed, inclusive). Return an array of the sum for each query. Optimise so repeated queries are fast.

arena_coding.title: Surrounded Regions
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(board)` — given an m×n board of "X" and "O", capture all regions surrounded by "X" by flipping all surrounded "O"s to "X". An "O" is surrounded if it is not connected (4-directional) to any "O" on the border. Return the modified board.

arena_coding.title: Stone Game
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(piles)` — Alice and Bob play a game with piles of stones. They take turns (Alice goes first) picking either the first or last pile. Both play optimally. Return true if Alice wins (has more stones), false if Bob wins. Note: Alice always wins when there are an even number of piles.

arena_coding.title: Longest Bitonic Subarray
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — a bitonic subarray first strictly increases then strictly decreases (or is purely increasing or purely decreasing). Return the length of the longest bitonic contiguous subarray.

arena_coding.title: Count Pairs With Target Sum
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums, target)` — return the count of all unique unordered pairs (i, j) where i < j such that nums[i] + nums[j] === target.

arena_coding.title: Binary Tree Right Side View
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nodes)` — given a binary tree as a level-order array (null for missing nodes), return the values visible when looking from the right side (the rightmost node at each level).

arena_coding.title: Longest Arithmetic Subsequence
arena_coding.description: Write `solve(nums)` — return the length of the longest arithmetic subsequence in the array. A subsequence is arithmetic if consecutive differences are all equal. Elements need not be contiguous.

arena_coding.title: Basic Calculator II
arena_coding.description: Write solve(s) — evaluate a string expression containing non-negative integers and operators +, -, *, / (integer division toward zero). No parentheses. Spaces may appear anywhere.

arena_coding.title: Interleaving String
arena_coding.description: Write solve(s1, s2, s3) — return true if s3 can be formed by interleaving s1 and s2 while maintaining the relative order of characters in each string.

arena_coding.title: Find Median from Data Stream
arena_coding.description: Write solve(ops) — implement a structure supporting addNum and findMedian. ops is an array of ["addNum", n] or ["findMedian"]. addNum returns null; findMedian returns the median as a float.

arena_coding.title: Bus Routes
arena_coding.description: Write solve(routes, source, target) — each routes[i] is the bus stop array for route i. Return the minimum number of buses you must take to travel from source to target, or -1 if impossible.

arena_coding.title: Find K Pairs With Smallest Sums
arena_coding.description: Write solve(nums1, nums2, k) — given two integer arrays sorted in ascending order, return the k pairs (u, v) with the smallest sums (one element from each array). Sort results by sum ascending, then by first element ascending.

arena_coding.title: Minimum Coins to Make Change
arena_coding.description: You have unlimited coins with denominations [1, 5, 10]. What is the minimum number of coins needed to make exactly 27 cents? Return just the number.

arena_coding.title: Count Pairs with Target Sum
arena_coding.description: Given the array [3, 5, 2, 7, 1, 6] and target sum 8, count how many unique index pairs (i, j) with i < j satisfy arr[i] + arr[j] == 8. Return the count.

arena_coding.title: Maximum Sliding Window Sum
arena_coding.description: Given the array [2, 1, 5, 1, 3, 2] and window size k=3, find the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray of exactly 3 elements.

arena_coding.title: Longest Common Subsequence Length
arena_coding.description: Find the length of the Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) of the strings 'ABCBDAB' and 'BDCABA'. Return just the length as a number.

arena_coding.title: Valid Parentheses Completion
arena_coding.description: The string '(()(' is missing some closing brackets. What is the minimum number of closing brackets ')' that must be appended to make it a valid parentheses string?

arena_coding.title: Grid Paths Count (DP)
arena_coding.description: A robot starts at the top-left corner of a 3×3 grid. It can only move right or down. How many distinct paths lead from the top-left to the bottom-right corner?
